user_problem: A note collection repeats observations with different wording, obscuring independent evidence and genuine disagreement.
unique_output: A clustering plan distinguishing exact duplicates, paraphrases, shared-source repetitions, related notes, and contradictions.
required_input: Labeled notes, source IDs, dates, quoted versus paraphrased markers, and explicit comparison rules.
critical_rule: Never merge notes solely by topical similarity; preserve separate provenance and all contradictory wording.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is duplicate-record-triage; this plans knowledge-note consolidation while protecting source independence rather than matching operational records.
acceptance_scenario: Input N1 and N2 both paraphrase source S1 saying delivery took two days; N3 from S2 says three days. Output clusters N1/N2 as shared-source repetition and retains N3 as contradiction.
